title: Order of Coverage: Manufacturer Warranty, Kestrel Limited Warranty and KestrelCare
content:
## 1. The stacking order

Coverage on one vehicle is stacked in a fixed order:

1. a manufacturer warranty or manufacturer certified pre-owned warranty pays first;
2. then the Kestrel limited warranty included with the purchase;
3. then the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan pays only the part of an approved repair that the earlier coverage did not pay.

| Coverage on the vehicle | Place in the order | What it pays |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer warranty or manufacturer certified pre-owned warranty | first | its own coverage |
| Kestrel limited warranty included with the purchase | second | its own coverage |
| KestrelCare plan | last | only the part of an approved repair the earlier coverage did not pay |

## 2. Where the limited warranty is in force

Holding the limited warranty changes the plan's handling: the clause applies while the Kestrel limited warranty of the purchase order is in force and covers the failed system.

The consequence this charter originally attached to that situation reads: "the plan's adjudication of that repair is limited to what the limited warranty decision left unpaid, and the plan's deductible is not applied a second time when the limited warranty already applied one." That consequence is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for KestrelCare remainder authorizations.

## 3. Points of reading

- A repair the manufacturer warranty pays in full leaves nothing for the KestrelCare plan to pay.
- The KestrelCare plan never pays ahead of the manufacturer warranty or the Kestrel limited warranty on the same repair.

superseded_clauses: the plan's adjudication of that repair is limited to what the limited warranty decision left unpaid, and the plan's deductible is not applied a second time when the limited warranty already applied one.
